# Definitions

**Phenotypes:**

- lri = wheeze OR rattle

- wlri = wheeze AND lri 

           = wheeze only = wari

- fari = fever

- flri = fever AND lri 

           = fever AND (wheeze OR rattle)

- wflri = wheeze AND fever AND lri 

           = wheeze AND fever = wfari

- sari = fever OR wheeze

- slri = (fever OR wheeze) AND lri 

           = (fever AND wheeze) OR (fever AND rattle) OR wheeze

**Timepoints:**

- 1,2, etc. = age 0 to 1y, 1 to 2y etc.

- 425 = age 0 to 425d

# Total number of events, within time point

```{r, echo=F, eval=T}
load("~/Documents/PhD/Project - CAS/S0_Prelim_data_check_clean/2016-10-26/output/2016-11-01_vir_respchart_var_gen.Rdata")
with(stat_long_sum.df, data.frame(time, lri, wlri, fari, flri, wflri, sari, slri))
```

# Mean number of events per individual, within timepoint

```{r, echo=F, eval=T}
with(stat_long_mean.df, data.frame(time, lri, wlri, fari, flri, wflri, sari, slri))
```

# Histograms

```{r, echo=F, eval=T, warning=F}
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())

virus_resp_sum_lri.df %>%
	filter(age!="0-1y", age!="3-4y", age!="4-5y") %>%
	ggplot(aes(x=frequency)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + facet_grid(.~age) +
	ggtitle("Number of LRIs in time period") +
	labs(x="Number of infections", y="Count") + xlim(c(-1,8))

virus_resp_sum_wlri.df %>%
	filter(age!="0-1y", age!="3-4y", age!="4-5y") %>%
	ggplot(aes(x=frequency)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + facet_grid(.~age) +
	ggtitle("Number of WLRIs in time period") +
	labs(x="Number of infections", y="Count")

virus_resp_sum_fari.df %>%
	filter(age!="0-1y", age!="3-4y", age!="4-5y") %>%
	ggplot(aes(x=frequency)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + facet_grid(.~age) +
	ggtitle("Number of FARIs in time period") +
	labs(x="Number of infections", y="Count") + xlim(c(-1,11))

virus_resp_sum_flri.df %>%
	filter(age!="0-1y", age!="3-4y", age!="4-5y") %>%
	ggplot(aes(x=frequency)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + facet_grid(.~age) +
	ggtitle("Number of FLRIs in time period") +
	labs(x="Number of infections", y="Count")

virus_resp_sum_wlri.df %>%
	filter(age!="0-1y", age!="3-4y", age!="4-5y") %>%
	ggplot(aes(x=frequency)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + facet_grid(.~age) +
	ggtitle("Number of WLRIs in time period") +
	labs(x="Number of infections", y="Count")

virus_resp_sum_wflri.df %>%
	filter(age!="0-1y", age!="3-4y", age!="4-5y") %>%
	ggplot(aes(x=frequency)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + facet_grid(.~age) +
	ggtitle("Number of wheezy and febrile LRIs in time period") +
	labs(x="Number of infections", y="Count")

virus_resp_sum_sari.df %>%
	filter(age!="0-1y", age!="3-4y", age!="4-5y") %>%
	ggplot(aes(x=frequency)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + facet_grid(.~age) +
	ggtitle("Number of SARIs (wheeze or fever) in time period") +
	labs(x="Number of infections", y="Count")

virus_resp_sum_slri.df %>%
	filter(age!="0-1y", age!="3-4y", age!="4-5y") %>%
	ggplot(aes(x=frequency)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + facet_grid(.~age) +
	ggtitle("Number of SLRIs (wheeze or fever AND LRI) in time period") +
	labs(x="Number of infections", y="Count")

```
